# Widget backend — the same claim, honestly scoped, for the gate's own fixtures

**Status:** built, smoke-tested, and doored, 2026-09-15. The BDD suite runs green against a real
daemon on a laptop.
**Opened:** 2026-09-15
**Door (from the UI):** `/ops`, "Widget" tile.

## What shipped

The widget backend (`platform/widget-bad/`) mounts the widget routes and is proven against a
real daemon.

**Not done:** no Dockerfile, no Deployment, no Service, and nothing running under this name in
the live cluster. This is inventory, not done.
